Card Q&A.q: When I played a blue Digimon, its DP became 0 by an opponent's effect that had already activated, so the Digimon was deleted at the same time it was played. Does this Tamer's [All Turns] effect still trigger in such cases?

Effect: [On Play] You may play 1 blue level 3 Digimon card from 1 of your Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
[All Turns] When you play a blue Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, you may place 1 blue level 4 or lower Digimon card as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
